name: search_movies
description: Search for movies by title or keyword. Returns title, director, release date, genre, description, and artwork.

query.description: Movie title or keyword to search for

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default 10)

name: search_tv_shows
description: Look up a TV SERIES BY NAME on TVmaze and get its facts in one call — "tell me about the TV show Breaking Bad", "when did The Sopranos air", "how was Chernobyl rated", "what network was Mad Men on", "is The Bear still running". Returns the show name, genres, premiere and end dates, status (Running/Ended), rating, network, summary and images for each match. THE entry point for a named series: it takes the TITLE directly, so a show known by name is answered here without resolving an id first.

query.description: TV show name or keyword to search for

name: get_tv_show
description: Full TVmaze record for ONE TV series by its numeric TVmaze show id — the episode list with air dates, plus network, status and rating. The id is an internal TVmaze number, so resolve it with search_tv_shows first and pass what that returns; when the caller names the show rather than an id, search_tv_shows answers directly.

id.description: TVmaze show ID (e.g., 1 for "Under the Dome")

name: get_tv_schedule
description: Check what's broadcasting on a specific date and country (e.g., 'US', 'GB'). Returns shows, times, and channels.
